description: This is a source file defining native Windows API interop methods for GDI (Graphics Device Interface) functions used within the PDFsharp .NET library. It provides P/Invoke definitions for Windows DLL functions related to device contexts, font handling, and GDI objects, conditionally compiled when the GDI symbol is defined.

classes.name: NativeMethods
classes.description: A static class containing P/Invoke signatures and constants for native Win32 GDI calls, conditionally included when GDI is defined.

methods.name: GetDC
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to a device context (DC) for the client area of a specified window or for the entire screen.

methods.name: ReleaseDC
methods.description: Releases a device context (DC), freeing it for use by other GDI functions.

methods.name: GetFontData
methods.description: Retrieves font metric data for a specified font.

methods.name: CreateDC
methods.description: Creates a device context for a specified device, driver, or port.

methods.name: CreateCompatibleDC
methods.description: Creates a memory device context compatible with the specified device.

methods.name: CreateFontIndirect
methods.description: Creates a logical font that has the characteristics specified in a LOGFONT structure.

methods.name: SelectObject
methods.description: Selects a GDI object into the specified device context.

methods.name: DeleteObject
methods.description: Deletes a GDI object, freeing all system resources associated with the object.

methods.name: GetDeviceCaps
methods.description: Retrieves device-specific information for the specified device context.
